genres: Family & Relationships in Young Adult Fiction
results.description: One choice. One season. Two different versions of love. . . Willa lives in Oak Falls, a small town that’s cosy and comforting and safe. Where the autumn months are full of red and gold leaves, pumpkin spice and bonfires. Willa’s not got a clear direction of travel for her life – and deep down she thinks she wants more. . . She is left some money by a distant aunt. The money comes with a condition: It must be used to see the world. So Willa has a choice. . . On one hand, she has her eye on London and a travel journalism course – but she needs to study for it, so must spend her weekends in the library, where Theo, a grumpy out-of-towner who thinks everything here is beneath him (and has an annoyingly handsome way of pushing his glasses up his nose) also hangs out. Or she can take her time and stay as she is, working at the coffee shop while she decides exactly what the perfect round-the-world trip would be. But she recently got a new boss: monosyllabic James, who's back in his childhood town with a broken heart. . . In alternating chapters see Willa live each version of her decision - and two different versions of falling in love . . .
